Integration Partners
Bookings
Showcase your business to local Google users.
WellnessLiving has partnered with Google to bring you this amazing tool that allows customers to find and book businesses, like yours, straight from their search results page or maps page. This partnership will sync your services directly with what is showcased on Google, keeping your services up-to-date and bookable online! Learn more 
A fitness membership program connecting you to thousands.
WellnessLiving has partnered with ClassPass to give you a chance to list your business on the ClassPass marketing, showcasing your studio or gym to a gigantic new segment of potential users. ClassPass users will be able to choose to include your business as one of their chosen sessions, leading to new clients and increased revenue.
The world’s largest corporate fitness platform.
WellnessLiving has partnered with Wellhub to bring you a game-changing service that will give you access to thousands of incentivized corporate customers, allowing you to earn more revenue and fill your classes to capacity. Every time a Wellhub user books a class at your studio, you get money! Learn more 
A network of premium studios
WellnessLiving has partnered with FitReserve—an all-access, multi-studio membership that allows users to mix and match in-person and virtual workouts. Join a growing network of more than 300,000 classes from over 1,000 premier studios across major cities in the U.S and start attracting new clients to your studio today! Learn more 
Virtual Services
The leading web-based video conferencing solution.
Extend your reach beyond your borders and easily connect online with more clients. Our seamless Zoom integration takes your business to the next level by syncing your online schedule with their platform, allowing you to offer live virtual services. Just one click of a button will get you and your clientele connected through WellnessLIving’s all-in-one solution. Learn more 
Automation
Automate any workflow
Connect WellnessLiving’s all-in-one business management software to your favorite apps with Zapier. With over 5,000 of the most popular apps to choose from, Zapier is the easiest way to automate everyday tasks and free up your valuable time. From lead management to data transfers, Zapier allows you to create flexible automations that perform different actions based on if/then logic. Best of all, no prior coding knowledge is required. Learn more 
Put your marketing on autopilot
Connect WellnessLiving with GoHighLevel to sync client data and automate your marketing. Trigger follow-ups when clients book or buy, keep profiles up-to-date, and turn activity into revenue-driving campaigns. Learn More 
Member Experience
Metrics that motivate results
Connect WellnessLiving to Spivi to boost member engagement and loyalty with data-driven workouts that keep your clients motivated to reach their health and fitness goals. Designed for fitness clubs and boutique studios, Spivi is an interactive and immersive fitness tracking platform turning each class into a complete fitness experience. The Spivi platform tracks performance data and gamifies the members’ fitness journey in a captivating workout experience using avatars and animation, live leaderboards, challenges, milestones, points, and awards. Learn more 
Dynamic fitness tracking technology.
WellnessLiving integrates with AccuroFit—the innovative heart rate monitoring and loyalty platform that encourages and rewards your clients for achieving goals. The branded wearable fitness tracking technology and Health App enables you to track clients’ performance and display key metrics on a screen at your gym or studio. It’s the perfect way to elevate your group training experience in real-time, incorporating performance metrics, challenges, leaderboards, and rewards to engage, motivate, and retain more of your clients. 
 Learn more 
Marketing
Stay in touch with this popular email marketing platform.
Looking to take how you communicate with your customers and prospects to the next level? WellnessLiving’s integration with Mailchimp will sync up your mailing lists and give you a chance to jazz up your email campaigns. Gather your insights, audience data and marketing channels together in one place in order to quickly achieve your goals.
Meet business goals with effective email and online marketing.
WellnessLiving’s integration with Constant Contact gives you the chance to create dynamic templates, access easy to use editors, robust audience building tools and more! Constant Contact makes email marketing easy, fun and educational. Connect with current prospective clients in order to strengthen and grow your business.
Enhance your studio communications and client experiences.
Keep your studio growing and your clients happy! Connect WellnessLiving to LenzVU—the ultimate CRM solution for fitness and wellness studios to enhance all communications and automate marketing campaigns, at each step of the client journey. LenzVU allows you to customize and streamline operations, providing you with the right tools to monitor sign ups, track patterns, increase engagement, and retain more clients. Learn more 
Accounting
Accurate books, zero manual effort.
One-time setup, then it just works. Sales, payments, and refunds post to QuickBooks daily on your schedule, categorized to match your setup, so closing your books takes no cleanup at all. Learn more 
Collections
Get professional support collecting overdue payments and retaining clients.
WellnessLiving has partnered with Aldous & Associates, who specializes in fitness industry client collections, to bring you an ultimate time-saving solution. Our partnership streamlines payment collection and keeps you up to date of the collection status of each client with an overdue account balance, and Aldous & Associates' call center works to keep clients coming back to your business. Learn more 
Security
A cloud-based Integrated access control solution.
Looking to upgrade your security system? WellnessLiving partners with Brivo to offer your staff members and clients secure, cloud-based, 24/7 access to your gym, health club, and wellness facility. Connect Brivo to WellnessLiving and manage access to multiple facilities and building amenities remotely. Provide a seamless, holistic security ecosystem. Offer exclusivity to your clients by turning their mobile devices into keys to access your facility. Improve your security and customer experience. Learn more 
Flexible Access Control, Tailored for Your Facility.
Passport Technologies provides a customizable door access solution to enhance security, streamline member management, and reduce operational overhead. Leverage client groups synced from WellnessLiving to define access based on membership type, account balance, or other criteria. Apply tailored schedules and permissions to control who can access your facility, when, and where. With an easy installation process and options like key fobs, cards, and Bluetooth entry, Passport Technologies enables you to deliver a secure, convenient experience for your clients and staff while maintaining full control over your facility’s access management. Learn More 
Business Intelligence
Benchmark Your Business with Real-Time Market Intelligence.
FitGrid is building the intelligence infrastructure for the fitness and wellness industry. By combining comparative benchmarking, business intelligence, client feedback, operational data, and AI-powered workflows, FitGrid helps operators understand what matters, identify opportunities faster, and make more informed decisions. Wellness businesses use FitGrid to benchmark performance, uncover revenue opportunities, see customer behavior, and turn insights into action across their organization. See how it works
